Vera N (Finance): Heads-up: PayFlow Inc invoice PF-2024 failed to auto-charge this AM. Stripe shows decline_code: card_declined / lost_card. Can billing attempt retries or should we offer wire?
Omar L (BillingOps): I see card ending in 6781, exp 11/26. No backup method. Our default is 3 retries at 24h. Customer is mid-tier; I'd suggest we allow 48h grace and offer wire/ACH.
Priya K (CS): I pinged their AP and got a quick reply: they lost the card (reported as lost) and ask for wire instructions. They can wire within 48 hours. They asked if service can remain active for that window.
payments-bot: Event: payment_intent.payment_failed {"code":"card_declined","amount":"120000"} (logged)
Vera N (Finance): Approve 48h grace for mid-tier. Omar, schedule 2 retries (24h), mark invoice PF-2024 as "awaiting payment - grace" and send secure wire template via encrypted email. Priya, confirm ETA and ask for remittance confirmation once sent.
Omar L (BillingOps): Done: retries scheduled, invoice labeled, note added: "customer requested wire; allow service 48h". Wire instructions template: 
Bank: Redwood Inference, LLC
Please request full routing via secure channel. Reference: PF-2024 / PayFlow Inc
Priya K (CS): Confirmed with AP: they will initiate wire within 24-48h and will send remittance. Asked them to copy our finance@redwood.com on confirmation.
Vera N (Finance): Good. If funds not received in 48h, restrict new model deployments but keep read-only access. Escalate to me at 72h.
Omar L (BillingOps): Noted. I'll update account and set a 72h follow-up.
Priya K (CS): Update 3h later: AP started wire and emailed remittance. I'll attach the email to the invoice when funds clear.
Vera N (Finance): Thanks team — closing until settlement posts."
